attchmntText: Banka BioLoo Limited has informed the Exchange about a copy of the newspaper publication regarding the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026
voiceSummary: Banka BioLoo Limited has published newspaper advertisements regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. The advertisements were published on 13 November 2026 in the Financial Express English Edition and Nava Telangana Telugu Edition. This publication complies with Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The information was released within 48 hours of the closure of the Board of Directors meeting. A copy of the release is available on the company website at https://www.bankabio.com/investors.

attchmntText: Unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026.
voiceSummary: Banka BioLoo Limited approved unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. The Board approved the results based on the Audit Committee's recommendation. For the half-year ended 30 September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 3247.37 lakhs. Profit before tax was Rs. 91.62 lakhs. Profit after tax was Rs. 78.70 lakhs. Basic earnings per share was Rs. 0.72. Total assets stood at Rs. 7573.84 lakhs. Trade receivables included Rs. 770.74 lakhs receivable from government bodies. The company has not made provisions against these receivables. Management is confident of recovery supported by a favorable interim order from the High Court of Telangana. Limited review reports were issued by independent auditors B.D. Saboo and Associates. The results are available on the company website and in prescribed newspapers.

attchmntText: Banka BioLoo Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Banka Bioloo Limited filed an investor presentation regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. Standalone total income for Q2 was Rs. 1,656 Lakhs, up 24.5% year-on-year. Standalone EBITDA was Rs. 157 Lakhs with a 9.5% margin. Standalone profit after tax was Rs. 41.6 Lakhs. Half-year standalone profit after tax was Rs. 78.7 Lakhs compared to a loss of Rs. 96.8 Lakhs in the previous year. The unexecuted order book stood at Rs. 83.4 Crores as of 30 September 2026. Q2 order booking was Rs. 16 Crores. Consolidated total income for Q2 was Rs. 1,187 Lakhs. Consolidated profit after tax for Q2 was Rs. 13.1 Lakhs. Half-year consolidated profit after tax was Rs. 9.2 Lakhs. Net debt to equity ratio was 0.82 times.

attchmntText: Banka BioLoo Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Banka BioLoo Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 12 November 2026. The Board approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for the half-year was Rs. 2231.35 lakhs, compared to Rs. 2415.30 lakhs in the previous year. The company reported a profit after tax of Rs. 9.19 lakhs for the half-year, versus a loss of Rs. 108.64 lakhs in the prior period. Basic earnings per share stood at Rs. 0.11. The auditor’s report highlighted trade receivables of Rs. 770.74 lakhs from government bodies, noting no provision was made due to management's confidence in recovery supported by a favorable High Court order. Financial results are available on the company website and in prescribed newspapers.

attchmntText: Significant movement in price has been observed in Banka BioLoo Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. Banka BioLoo Limited has submitted their response.
voiceSummary: Banka BioLoo Limited responded to the National Stock Exchange regarding a query on significant price movement of its securities. The company stated it has made all necessary disclosures under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. Management confirmed there are no pending announcements that could impact the stock price. The company asserted it has not shared any price-sensitive information with market intermediaries or other parties. It attributed the recent price spurt entirely to market conditions and stated it is not connected to the movement. The company committed to continuing all requisite disclosures to the Exchange in compliance with applicable regulations.
